_documentation.enable: Operator must replace values, grant only required scopes, enable explicitly; no real credentials are included.
_documentation.pack_policy: Assign exact google.* tools and allowed_connections=[google-office] to the intended agent only.
_documentation.vault: PLATFORM_VAULT_KEYS_JSON maps version IDs to independently generated base64 32-byte keys, PLATFORM_VAULT_ACTIVE_KEY selects one. Never commit key values.
_documentation.callback: Exact same origin as UI, path /oauth/google/callback; proxy access logs must omit query strings. Cookies/localStorage are not used.
